notes: Historical baseline only, before the current shared Icon, G1, F1 and F2 changes. Default and disabled snapshots cover dark/light × English/Chinese. Hover, focus, active, pre-edit and edit captures cover dark English only. Files named pressed do not prove a simultaneous held-pointer frame and are 未验证.
Numeric edit capture bounds are the shell bounds before editing; the AX child editor differs from its clipped shell. Existing native renderer geometry tests cover shell width stability.
Historical native focus was observed, but these images do not verify the current native focusVisible inset ring.

Historical final static screenshots used screencapture after computer.run timed out and that computer session closed. The word final in legacy filenames describes that historical capture batch, not the current implementation.
